exclusions.source_text: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status of 0 or 1.
Age ≥ 18 years (or \> legal age within the country if it is older than 18 years).
exclusions.threshold: age > legal age if older than 18

exclusions.source_text: Untreated symptomatic central nervous system or leptomeningeal metastases.
History of other malignancy within the past 5 years.
Presence or history of any of the following viral infections: HIV, Hepatitis C, Hepatitis B, and active severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2).
